review_candidates.title: Performance Marketing Manager
review_candidates.description: Waarom deze rol bij jou past Je wilt meer dan optimaliseren: je bouwt aan de performance marketingorganisatie van morgen. Je zoekt internationale schaal: van Nederland en België tot nieuwe Europese groeimarkten. Je wilt echte verantwoordelijkheid: miljoenenbudgetten, een eigen team en zichtbare impact op de bedrijfsresultaten. Dit ga je doen My Jewellery groeit hard: met meer dan 1000 collega's en 60 boutiques in Nederland, België, Duitsland en Frankrijk én nieuwe markten op komst. Performance marketing is klaar voor de volgende fase: van goed naar scherp. Jij bouwt die structuur. Je stuurt een team aan, beheert miljoenenbudgetten over meerdere landen en kanalen en zorgt dat performance en merk elkaar versterken om commerciële resultaten te realiseren. Als Performance Marketing Manager bepaal je de strategie voor SEA, paid social, affiliates en display. Je blijft dicht genoeg op de uitvoering om te weten wat werkt en waar kansen liggen. Je stuurt op incrementaliteit en weet wanneer data voldoende richting geeft om beslissingen te nemen op land-, categorie- en kanaalniveau. Je maakt onze betaalde kanalen slimmer met AI-gedreven automatisering en vertaalt dit naar de dagelijkse werkwijze van het team. Internationaal denken is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van volwassen én groeiende markten en weet hoe je schaal realiseert zonder het merk uit het oog te verliezen. Daarnaast werk je intensief samen met collega's van E-commerce, Retail en Inkoop. Je denkt vanuit commercieel resultaat en bouwt vanzelfsprekend bruggen tussen teams om gezamenlijk meer impact te maken. Jouw taken Je ontwikkelt en implementeert de performance marketingstrategie voor SEA, paid social, affiliates en display; Je beheert en optimaliseert grote mediabudgetten met focus op rendement, groei en incrementaliteit; Je stuurt het performance marketingteam aan en begeleidt collega's in hun ontwikkeling; Je analyseert data, attributiemodellen en marketingmixen om kansen en verbeteringen te identificeren; Je implementeert AI-gedreven oplossingen en automatiseringen om campagnes slimmer en efficiënter te maken; Je werkt nauw samen met Marketing, E-commerce, Retail en Inkoop om commerciële doelstellingen te realiseren. Hoe succes eruit ziet na 1 jaar? Er ligt een gedragen performance marketingstrategie, uitgewerkt per land, categorie en kanaal; De performance resultaten in Nederland en België liggen boven target en zijn verder geoptimaliseerd op marge en incrementaliteit; Duitsland laat aantoonbare groei zien en er ligt een schaalbare aanpak klaar voor toekomstige markten; Het team opereert op hoog niveau, neemt eigenaarschap en signaleert kansen voordat hierom gevraagd wordt; Slimme automatisering en AI zijn geen experiment meer, maar een vast onderdeel van de dagelijkse werkwijze; E-commerce, Retail en Inkoop zien performance marketing als een strategische partner die hun resultaten versterkt en processen versnelt; Er staat een schaalbare en herhaalbare campagnestructuur die continu verder wordt aangescherpt. Wat jij meebrengt Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen performance marketing, met verantwoordelijkheid voor meerdere kanalen en substantiële marketingbudgetten binnen een e-commerce of DTC-omgeving; Aantoonbare ervaring in het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team; Sterke kennis van en ervaring met incrementaliteit, attributiemodellen en datagedreven besluitvorming; Ervaring met performance marketingcampagnes in meerdere landen of markten; Je beweegt je moeiteloos tussen strategie en operatie en weet beide naar een hoger niveau te tillen; Je hebt gevoel voor merkbouw en begrijpt hoe performance en branding elkaar versterken. Over My Jewellery My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega’s bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

The Advanced Practice Provider has the opportunity to be part of a value-based, patient-centered care model, providing quality driven managed care with a population health focus. Highlights Schedule Patient visits occur 3-4 days/week in the patients’ home with 1-2 days/week telehealth visits (varies by market) No on‑call, overnights, weekends, including paid company holidays 30–90-minute visit lengths based on appointment type and patient needs *All schedule responsibilities may evolve with business needs Total Rewards Earn a competitive base salary commensurate with experience and education Grow your clinical skillset and earn $2,500 for every core and specialty competency you complete Invest in your longevity with a $5,000 annual anniversary bonus Maximize your income potential with up to 15% in additional bonuses that will be paid out on a quarterly or annual basis Start earning bonuses sooner — eligibility begins after just 3 months From your driveway to the patient’s house, we’ve got you covered with mileage reimbursement. Support your professional growth and continued education with reimbursement for your CEU/CME expenses. Comprehensive Benefits - Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance program, employer-paid and voluntary life insurance, disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts. Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources. Time Off & Leave – 20 PTO days, 7 paid holidays, and 1 floating day to make your own, and paid parental leave. Wellness & Growth – Work life assistance resources, physical wellness perks, mental health support, employee referral program, and BenefitHub for employee discounts. Responsibilities Provide evidence‑based, patient‑focused care that reduces avoidable hospitalizations and improves quality of life directly in the patient’s home Perform comprehensive assessments, including initial evaluations, annual wellness exams, follow‑ups, acute urgent visits, and post‑discharge visits. Educate patients and caregivers on disease management, preventive care, medications, and diagnostic testing Participate in recurring virtual integrated care team meetings Engage in quality assurance activities, including audits and documentation reviews, to ensure compliance with state board requirements and clinical best practices May practice in a variety of care settings beyond the patient’s home, including skilled nursing facilities (SNFs), assisted living facilities (ALFs), hospitals, and other affiliated clinical settings, as applicable. Perform point-of-care testing (A1C and Spirometry), prescribe medications, order tests, and collaborate with patient’s Monogram physician Coordinate care with PCPs, specialists, and ancillary services Complete documentation accurately and in a timely manner Position Requirements Active and unrestricted RN and NP license, or Physician Assistant license Board certification (NP: ANCC/AANP | PA: NCCPA) Current and unrestricted DEA certificate, or eligibility to obtain Minimum of two (2) years of direct patient care experience Field‑based role requiring travel to patient homes, reliable transportation, valid driver’s license, and auto insurance BLS certification (supported during onboarding) Demonstrated initiative and independent, critical thinking, and decision-making skills Knowledge of and compliance with federal/state regulations (HIPAA, OSHA) Prior experience with EHR systems (e.g. Athena, Salesforce, Epic) Previous experience conducting annual wellness or comprehensive visits preferred Background in managed care, population health, or value‑based care preferred Benefits Comprehensive Benefits - Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance program, employer-paid and voluntary life insurance, disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources Wellness & Growth – Work life assistance resources, physical wellness perks, mental health support, employee referral program, and BenefitHub for employee discounts About Monogram Health Monogram Health is a leading multispecialty provider of in-home, evidence-based care for the most complex of patients who have multiple chronic conditions. Monogram health takes a comprehensive and personalized approach to a person’s health, treating not only a disease, but all of the chronic conditions that are present - such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, heart failure, depression, COPD, and other metabolic disorders. Monogram Health employs a robust clinical team, leveraging specialists across multiple disciplines including nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology, pulmonology, behavioral health, and palliative care to diagnose and treat health issues; review and prescribe medication; provide guidance, education, and counselling on a patient’s healthcare options; as well as assist with daily needs such as access to food, eating healthy, transportation, financial assistance, and more. Monogram Health is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and on holidays, to support and treat patients in their home. Monogram Health’s personalized and innovative treatment model is proven to dramatically improve patient outcomes and quality of life while reducing medical costs across the health care continuum.

review_candidates.title: Maintenance Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description ATHR Gallery, founded in 2009 in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, is a pioneering contemporary art gallery dedicated to advancing Middle Eastern art on a global stage. The gallery acts as a cultural bridge between Saudi Arabia and the wider world, showcasing artists who work across diverse disciplines, from traditional painting and sculpture to experimental and unconventional practices. ATHR’s program reflects a wide range of narratives, spanning personal stories to broad cultural themes, and is responsive to the evolving local art scene. Building on the success of its flagship Jeddah space, ATHR has expanded to Al-Ula and Riyadh and established the ATHR Foundation and AKTHR to support emerging artists and cultural projects across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf region. Role Description The Maintenance Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Jeddah, responsible for overseeing the upkeep, safety, and functionality of gallery spaces and related facilities. This role includes planning and supervising maintenance and repair activities for building systems, equipment, and exhibition infrastructure to ensure minimal downtime and optimal operating conditions. The Maintenance Manager coordinates preventive maintenance schedules, manages maintenance staff and contractors, and maintains accurate records of work orders, inspections, and inventory. The role also involves monitoring compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards, supporting exhibition installations from a facilities perspective, and responding promptly to maintenance requests to support seamless gallery operations. Key Responsibilities: Infrastructure & Reliability – Keep electrical and mechanical systems continuously operational, establish preventive maintenance plans, manage infrastructure risks, and plan asset lifecycle/replacement. Electrical Leadership – Act as the main technical authority for electrical infrastructure, including MV/LV systems, transformers, generators, UPS, lighting, fire alarm interfaces, metering, and BMS integration. Contractor Management – Manage outsourced maintenance contractors, monitor SLAs and preventive maintenance performance, coordinate shutdowns, and investigate major technical incidents. Operations & Emergencies – Lead technicians and contractors, approve maintenance work, manage manpower, and lead responses to power, HVAC, plumbing, and life-safety emergencies. Compliance & Preventive Maintenance – Maintain technical documentation and asset registers, enforce safety procedures, conduct inspections/testing, and ensure compliance with Saudi Building Code and Civil Defense requirements . Budget & Asset Planning – Manage OPEX/CAPEX forecasts, maintenance budgets, asset replacement planning, and evaluate whether maintenance activities should be outsourced or brought in-house. Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering . Experience: 6–8 years in facilities, maintenance, or infrastructure management, including at least 2–3 years in a supervisory/managerial role overseeing electrical and mechanical systems. Electrical Systems: Strong hands-on/management experience with MV/LV systems, transformers, generators, ATS, UPS, distribution systems, and electrical infrastructure . Mechanical & Building Systems: Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, vertical transportation, and BMS . Maintenance Management: Experience developing and managing preventive maintenance programs , technical inspections, asset registers, and maintenance documentation. Contractor Management: Proven ability to manage FM/maintenance contractors, SLAs, manpower, and contractor performance . Safety & Compliance: Strong knowledge of Saudi Civil Defense requirements, safety procedures, life-safety systems, and relevant building regulations . Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, coordinate multiple disciplines, manage emergencies, and make critical operational decisions. Financial & Strategic: Experience with maintenance budgets, OPEX/CAPEX planning, lifecycle planning, and asset replacement forecasting .

review_candidates.title: Growth Workflow Manager, Performance & Paid
review_candidates.description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Performance marketing is being rebuilt from first principles. The manual processes of bid management, creative iteration, budget allocation, and audience targeting are being replaced by agent systems that detect signals, make decisions, and execute continuously, learning from every result. This is not incremental improvement. It is a different model. As Growth Workflow Manager (Performance & Paid Growth), you sit at the intersection of paid growth expertise and AI systems thinking. You are the domain expert who makes the automation intelligent. The engineers build what you spec. The agents run what you design. Your job is to define the logic, what signals matter, what decisions should be automated, what guardrails must exist, what the creative feedback loop looks like across paid channels, and then work alongside the build team to bring it to life. While your primary focus is performance and paid growth, you will also contribute to automating other growth levers, including CRO, incentives, referrals, and cross-channel workflows, as the engine expands. The domain expertise is your anchor. The systems thinking is what scales it. This role is for someone who has run growth at scale and found themselves constantly asking why are we doing this manually. If you've felt the ceiling of what human-operated paid growth can achieve and want to build the system that breaks through it, this is that role. The opportunity Define and spec automation workflows for paid growth, from creative fatigue detection to budget reallocation to geo level channel mix optimization to audience signal processing Work directly with the build team to translate your workflow specs into working agent automations QA agent outputs, review what the system produces, identify where it falls short, and define the corrections that improve it Refine creative and copy variants generated by the AI creative layer, applying domain judgment to what will perform before the data confirms it Define knowledge base inputs for the paid growth agents, what rules, guardrails, and campaign logic should be codified and kept current Monitor workflow performance and continuously improve, this system compounds with your input, it does not run itself Extend your systems thinking to other growth levers, CRO, incentives, referrals, and lifecycle, as the engine expands across growth functions What You Bring 4+ years in performance or paid growth, you have run campaigns at scale across major paid channels and understand the mechanics deeply Systems thinking, you can map a growth workflow as a series of triggers, decisions, actions, and measurements.
